name: Firelight
source:
Three weeks ago, your father and sister disappeared while on a trip to a kingdom in the East. 

After days without contact, you, Sylas, decide to embark on an investigation to discover what happened to them. All clues lead you to the mysterious Ashen Woods, a forest infamous for causing disappearances.

[From [url=https://arciel55.itch.io/firelight-game]Itch.io[/url]]
